# Part IX: Geospatial Analytics {.unnumbered}

Many audit questions have a location. Is a beneficiary's address real? Are many beneficiaries shown at one house? Is the distance claimed for transport plausible? This part shows how to draw maps, and how to convert addresses into coordinates and back, for checks on location.

The chapters in this part are:

- @sec-maps, drawing maps, and checking where beneficiaries really are.
- @sec-geocoding, from addresses to coordinates.
- @sec-revgeocoding, from coordinates to addresses.
